results.title: SEBI eases FPI onboarding by allowing digitally signed Power of Attorney
results.description: SEBI has eased the FPI onboarding process by allowing digitally signed powers of attorney, removing notarisation and other certification requirements and cutting paperwork for foreign investors.

results.title: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir Elected 23rd President of Bangladesh
results.description: Dhaka, August 20, 2026 (Yes Punjab News) BNP candidate Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has been elected the 23rd President of Bangladesh after defeating Oli Ahmed, who was backed by the Jamaat-e-Islami-led 11-party alliance, in the country’s first contested presidential election in more than three decades.
